Text2Speech.dev

ResumeLoomr.com

A resume builder with structured editing, live preview, and print-ready output in one place.

ResumeLoomr lets users build a resume section by section while the final document updates live beside the editor.

It focuses on practical workflow details like autosave, section reordering, template switching, and a clean print flow.

  • Live resume preview that updates as you type
  • Autosave with visible save-state feedback
  • Reorderable sections and repeatable entries
  • Template switching and print-ready output

WebcamSign.com

A React-based web app that uses MediaPipe hand landmarks and webcam input to create signatures through real-time pinch gestures.

WebcamSign turns a live webcam feed into a gesture-based signature pad. A hand-landmark model tracks the user in real time, and a thumb-to-index pinch works as pen down and pen up so the signature can be drawn without touching the screen.

The interaction loop is built for stability and responsiveness: each frame is processed with requestAnimationFrame, gesture state lives in refs to avoid unnecessary React re-renders, hysteresis thresholds reduce flicker, and the canvas stays synchronized to video resolution for clean output.

  • Live webcam hand-landmark tracking with MediaPipe
  • Pinch gesture detection to start and stop drawing
  • Real-time canvas signature rendering from normalized landmarks
  • Clear and export flow for finished signatures
  • Performance-aware React patterns for stable gesture input
  • React
  • MediaPipe
  • HTML Canvas
  • WebRTC
  • requestAnimationFrame
